jobs.title: Senior PHP Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Fullstack PHP Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.

About the Client

The client is an established international software company developing a B2B platform that helps organizations manage customer relationships, sales processes, and commercial data more effecti
jobs.requirementsSection:
• 5+ years of professional software development experience, including strong expertise in PHP and JavaScript.
  • Solid experience with modern PHP frameworks (Laravel, Symfony, or similar).
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React, Vue.js, or Angular).
  • Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and integrating third-party services.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL), including query optimization and database design.
  • Good understanding of software architecture, design patter
